claims.claim: N159 lies 161000 light-years away in the Large Magellanic Cloud.
claims.episode_span: The James Webb Space Telescope captured a turbulent star-forming region named N159 in the Large Magellanic Cloud, 161 000 light-years away.

claims.supporting_quote: This is a star-forming region named LHA 120-N 159, or simply N159, located 161 000 light-years away in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC)

claims.claim: The RS-25 engine test on October 21 lasted almost eight-and-a-half minutes at 111 percent power.
claims.episode_span: Test teams fired developmental RS-25 engine No. 10001 for almost eight-and-a-half minutes at NASA’s Stennis Space Center on October 21. The engine reached the 111 percent power level required for new production engines on the Space Launch System.
claims.source_title: NASA Conducts RS-25 Engine Test in Support of Future Artemis Missions
claims.supporting_quote: Test teams fired the developmental engine for almost eight-and-a-half minutes (500 seconds), the same amount of time RS-25 engines fire during launch of NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket. During the test, operators also fired the engine up to the 111% power level

claims.claim: Perseverance reached 45.22 kilometres driven on Sol 2006.
claims.episode_span: Perseverance reached 45.22 kilometres on Sol 2006, setting a new record for distance driven on another celestial body.

claims.supporting_quote: On Sol 2006 (Oct. 11, 2026), its odometer reached 45.22 kilometers (28.10 miles), setting a new record for the farthest distance driven on another celestial body.

claims.claim: Light from the Andromeda galaxy left its stars 2.5 million years ago.

claims.supporting_quote: When we look at Andromeda, we're seeing it as it was approximately 2.5 million years ago.
